what: The hardware evidence that qualifies S2 C2-packed-any (QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1): packed rounds at any position through one K64j 0x27 program per bundle (s2-design.md rev 2, W7 and 6.2). packed_any_admission.check_evidence reads it at every c2-packed attach; its sha256 is pinned there (EVIDENCE_SHA256), so a new record changes both in one commit.
provenance: CB2b is written from run 36260236826 (experiment/c2-serving-v52, commit af1e3ebb): its cardm report cardm/reader-20260926T174702.json (sha256 246a09a7b0e1e5f7), by a script that takes every value from that report and its console, and checks the report against the admission's K64j binary, kernels and reader sha. The watcher pass before it is run 36255706983 (experiment/c2-serving-v51). CB2a was re-read from run 36239779235's report (cardm/card-20260926T114459.json, sha256 d5c1d05b803e501f) and the K64j binary from card-b-v7 run 36222920898's build summary and MANIFEST.sha256 when CB2b was recorded; both match what was here. CB1 is transcribed from the goal-c2-serving memory note and the S2 build brief (2026-09-26); its run artifact was not re-read. sources names extent_attention_replay.py as every S2 branch holds it (5633fc3a, W1 b35bb070, merged at 937bd2f7): CB2b ran the checkout's copy of it (/bench/ci) at these bytes; the admission guard is in serving_buffer_pool, never in the reader.

CB1.what: K64j K1/K3: the runtime extent (0x20) at cur_pos E - 1 equals the compile-time call at capacity E

CB2a.what: K2 (native causal B1 per row == the extent path, bitwise; it sets the exactness policy), X7 (0x7 narrow == 0x7 wide with the real -inf tail) and Z (the 15 stale-writer families in one trace)
CB2a.harness: optimisation/ttnn-op/k64j/k64j_card_b.py --sections K2,X7,Z --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --variants normal,peaky --no-timing (the cardm action; card B is reserved)

CB2b.what: W10b: the real extent readers over pool-like lent storage - R1 (the pinned mask kernel at capacity 256 == narrow_mask_host, at G8B2, G4B3 and G4B1), S (construction and restage staging: word, cur_pos and tables read back), R2 (each segment == the 0x7 compile-time call with the wide -inf mask at capacity E, over more than 50 families), R4 (idle segments at 0/32 on the zero table)
